newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat closes higher on mill buying.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat closes higher on mill buying.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed higher on mill buying and short covering amid thin volume, traders said.
"It was pretty light volume with short covering and mill buying," a trader said.
Cargill Investor Services bought one million bushels of July and Benson Quinn sold one million bushels of September, traders said.
"Benson Quinn was the main bull spreader," the trader said. The firm did 400,000 bushels of July/September at nine to 10 cents, premium July, the traders said.
MGE spring wheat futures closed 1-1/4 to 5-1/2 cents per bushel higher, with July up 1-1/4 at $3.73-1/4. September was up two cents at $3.63-1/2.
Barley futures closed unchanged to 0.10 cent per cwt lower with July unchanged at $6.20 per cwt.
MGE spring wheat futures volume was estimated at 16,012 contracts, below the 29,784 traded Tuesday.
